key_insight: WeVisForensics improves AI-generated video detection by jointly refining an investigator agent and forensic inspectors that ground verdicts in localized visual and audio evidence.
engineering_relevance: The framework offers a design for adaptive forensic pipelines that select relevant inspections rather than relying on fixed workflows or single-pass reasoning.
method: An investigator selects artifact types, inspection windows, and when to conclude.
Specialized inspector agents examine visual and audio cues and return forensic evidence.
Dual-timescale policy optimization pairs fast investigator reinforcement learning with slower inspector refinement guided by annotated artifact intervals.
evidence_signal: The authors introduce ForenCue-30K and report 95.2% average detection accuracy across in-domain, out-of-domain, and agentic benchmarks, described as 9.0% above the strongest prior detector.
watch_item: Deployment latency, inspection costs, and robustness to future video generators are not established by the abstract.
paper_title: WeVisForensics: Self-Evolving Agent for Omni AI-Generated Video Detection
